crossRefs.note: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”

translations.web: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
translations.bsb: casts spells, consults a medium or spiritist, or inquires of the dead.
translations.kjv: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
